paragraphs.text: Strategic Role: India's corporate center for processing raw black gram into unbroken, de-husked Urad Gota. Sets national quality benchmarks for wet-grinding and batter performance.

Key Facilities: Over 100 specialized dal mills located in and around Tenali, Guntur, and Vijayawada; advanced trichromatic optical color sorters, water-polishing drums, and packaging lines supplying South Indian markets.
Catchment Areas: Krishna-Godavari delta rice-fallow belts (Guntur, Bapatla, NTR, Krishna, West Godavari); containerized import receipts of Myanmar Black Matpe via Chennai and Visakhapatnam ports.

summary.text: In Indian agricultural economics (Directorate of Economics & Statistics, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / ICAR-IIPR), Urad / Black Gram (Vigna mungo) is the third most important pulse crop in India, following chickpea (chana) and pigeonpea (tur). India is the world's largest producer, consumer, and importer of black gram, contributing roughly 70% of global production.

protection.name: Mungbean Yellow Mosaic India Virus (MYMIV) (Transmitted by Whitefly Bemisia tabaci)
protection.geography: All-India Commercial Belts (Devastating in Kharif & Summer)
protection.impact: Leaves show irregular, scattered bright yellow patches interspersed with green tissue; patches coalesce, turning the entire leaf completely golden-yellow ("Yellow Mosaic"); severe early infection stunts plants, causes flower abortion, and leads to tiny, deformed pods with shriveled seeds; causes 40–100% yield loss.
protection.passage: Black Gram — source table 128, row 2. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Powdery Mildew (Erysiphe polygoni)
protection.geography: Rice-Fallow Coastal Belts (Heavy in AP, Tamil Nadu, Odisha)
protection.impact: White powdery fungal patches appear on upper leaf surfaces; rapidly spreads to stems and pods; leaves turn chlorotic, curl, and dry up prematurely; pods remain stunted with small, light seeds; severe under heavy morning dew.
protection.passage: Black Gram — source table 128, row 3. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Cercospora Leaf Spot (Cercospora cruenta, C. canescens)
protection.impact: Small, circular-to-irregular brown spots with reddish-purple margins and grey centers on leaves; spots coalesce, forming large necrotic patches; causes extensive premature defoliation ("leaf drop") during pod filling.
protection.passage: Black Gram — source table 128, row 4. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Spotted Pod Borer (Maruca vitrata) & Gram Pod Borer (Helicoverpa)
protection.impact:
Maruca: Larvae web together flowers, leaves, and green pods into dense clusters, feeding on buds and seeds from inside.

Helicoverpa: Larvae bore clean circular holes into pods, feeding on ripening seeds with their bodies partially exposed.
protection.passage: Black Gram — source table 128, row 5. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Root Rot & Web Blight (Rhizoctonia solani)
protection.impact: Dark, sunken, water-soaked brown lesions on lower stems and root collars; plants wilt and collapse; in humid weather, fungal mycelium webs together lower leaves into a brown decayed blight.
protection.passage: Black Gram — source table 128, row 6. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Pulse Beetle / Bruchid (Callosobruchus chinensis, C. maculatus)
protection.impact: Adults lay small whitish eggs on dried seed surfaces; grubs burrow inside cotyledons, hollowing out grains and leaving round exit holes; turns lots into powdery frass.
protection.passage: Black Gram — source table 128, row 7. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.
